title: Traffic-VL: Reinforced Vision-Language Models for Generalizable End-to-End Traffic Signal Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.06353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing traffic signal control methods typically rely on structured traffic states produced by dedicated perception pipelines. Emerging visual approaches often use idealized simulator images and convert them into intermediate representations before control, limiting their ability to directly exploit roadside visual observations. To bridge both the visual-domain and perception-to-decision gaps, we introduce SynTra-V and Traffic-VL. SynTra-V converts physics-based traffic simulations into photorealistic multi-view surveillance imagery across diverse road topologies and sensing conditions, and automatic semantic auditing checks that control-critical geometry, vehicle movements, and lane semantics match the simulator state. Traffic-VL is an eight-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view images and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states. translated_title: Traffic-VL：用于可泛化端到端交通信号控制的强化视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 现有的交通信号控制方法通常依赖于由专用感知流水线产生的结构化交通状态。而新兴的视觉方法往往使用理想化的仿真器图像，并在控制之前将其转换为中间表示，这限制了它们直接利用路边视觉观测的能力。为了同时弥合视觉域差距和从感知到决策的差距，我们提出了SynTra-V和Traffic-VL。SynTra-V将基于物理的交通仿真转换为逼真的多视角监控图像，涵盖多样的道路拓扑结构和感知条件，并通过自动语义审计来检查控制关键的几何结构、车辆运动和车道语义是否与仿真器状态相匹配。Traffic-VL是一个80亿参数的视觉语言模型，它能够直接将同步的多视角图像和自然语言相位描述映射为信号决策，而无需中间结构化状态。
tldr: 该论文提出了SynTra-V逼真仿真数据集和Traffic-VL视觉语言模型，后者可直接从多视角监控图像与自然语言相位描述生成交通信号控制决策，无需中间结构化状态，实现了更可泛化的端到端交通信号控制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SynTra-V, a photorealistic traffic simulation dataset, and Traffic-VL, an 8-billion-parameter vision-language model that directly maps synchronized multi-view surveillance imagery and natural-language phase descriptions to signal decisions without intermediate structured states, enabling generalizable end-to-end traffic signal control.
